investigation_notes.Description: Multiple high-entropy DNS A queries for mdnplay.dev were observed from wkst-dev-14 and the observed packet size was significantly larger than typical DNS traffic. The normalized root domain (mdnplay.dev) is an established domain created on 2021-12-14 (approximately 1515 days old), and inspection of subdomains found hex-like strings but no Base64-decoded payloads containing system paths or commands. No recent host events or similar alerts were found, so this activity is assessed as Low Priority due to the mature domain age and lack of decoded sensitive data.
